info.title: dotnet-shf
info.description: Laravel-Artisan-style code generator for Strawhats Framework services. Scaffolds features, endpoints, entities, providers, and persistence projects.

commands.name: make:caching
commands.description: Scaffold a caching provider project (Caching.<Name>) wired to ICacheProvider

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --with-package
options.description:
Add a NuGet PackageReference to the
generated csproj (e.g.
StackExchange.Redis)
permissive floor if omitted

options.name: --package-version
options.description:
Version for --with-package. Defaults to a
permissive floor if omitted

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print what would be written without
touching disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Business project.
Auto-detected from cwd if omitted

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description:
Caching provider name in PascalCase, e.g. Redis, Memcached,
DistributedSqlServer

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --query
options.description:
Force GET endpoint wired to a Query slice
(Result<Response> envelope)

options.name: --command
options.description:
Force POST endpoint wired to a Command slice
(Result envelope, no response)

options.name: --route
options.description:
Route override. Defaults to
api/v1/<Domain>/<Operation>

options.name: --summary
options.description:
OpenAPI summary. Defaults to the operation name
humanized

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the WebApi project. Auto-detected from cwd
if omitted

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description:
Endpoint identifier in the form <Domain>/<Operation>, e.g.
Weather/GetForecastsByCity

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --properties
options.description:
Comma-separated Name:Type pairs, e.g.
"Title:string,Quantity:int,Notes:string?"

options.name: --record
options.description:
Emit a positional record instead of a class with
set-accessors

options.name: --no-id
options.description: Skip the default Id (Guid) property

options.name: --no-timestamp
options.description:
Skip the default CreatedAt (DateTimeOffset)
property

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Domain project. Auto-detected from
cwd if omitted

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description:
Entity identifier in the form <Domain>/<Name>, e.g.
Weather/Forecast

commands.name: make:feature
commands.description: Scaffold a CQRS feature (request, handler, optional response)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --command
options.description:
Force command (no response) shape even if the name
starts with Get/List/Find

options.name: --query
options.description: Force query (with response) shape regardless of name

options.name: --no-response
options.description:
Skip generating the Response class (only meaningful
for queries)

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Business project. Auto-detected from cwd
if omitted

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description:
Feature path in the form <Domain>/<Operation>, e.g.
Weather/GetForecastsByCity

commands.name: make:migration
commands.description: Add a design-time EF Core migration to a persistence project

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --persistence
options.description:
Persistence project name (e.g.
Persistence.PostgreSql). Auto-detected when
there is exactly one Persistence.* project
under src/

options.name: --output-dir
options.description:
Migrations output directory relative to the
persistence project. Defaults to Migrations

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print the dotnet ef command without invoking
it

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Business project. Auto-detected
from cwd if omitted

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description:
Migration name in PascalCase (e.g. AddForecastTable,
RenameUserEmail)

commands.name: make:persistence
commands.description: Scaffold a persistence project (PostgreSQL / SQL Server / SQLite)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --connection-string
options.description:
Override the default connection string
written to appsettings.json. If unset, a
placeholder default is used

options.name: --localdb
options.description:
sqlserver only — use LocalDB as the
default connection string. Ignored for
other variants

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print what would be written without
touching disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Business project.
Auto-detected from cwd if omitted

arguments.name: VARIANT
arguments.description: One of: postgres, sqlserver, sqlite, couchbase

commands.name: make:provider
commands.description: Scaffold a provider contract + project skeleton

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --first-driver
options.description:
Seed one driver immediately (e.g. Twilio for
Sms). Adds it to the ProviderType enum and
the factory switch

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite existing files

options.name: --dry-run
options.description:
Print what would be written without touching
disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Business project. Auto-detected
from cwd if omitted; the other targets derive
from it

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Provider name in PascalCase, e.g. Sms, Storage, Payment

commands.name: make:provider-driver
commands.description: Add a new driver to an existing provider

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the driver file if it already exists

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching disk

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the Business project. Auto-detected from cwd
if omitted

arguments.name: PROVIDER
arguments.description:
Existing provider name (e.g. Mail, Sms). Must match a
Providers.<Provider> project

arguments.name: DRIVER
arguments.description: New driver name in PascalCase (e.g. Smtp, Twilio, SendGrid)

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information
